arxiv-2104-00497.title: Dynamical structures of retrograde resonances: analytical and numerical studies Dynamical structures of retrograde resonances: analytical and numerical studies – A 2021
arxiv-2104-00497.creator: Hanlun Lei, Jian Li
arxiv-2104-00497.description: Abstract In this work, retrograde mean motion resonances (MMRs) are investigated by means of analytical and numerical approaches. Initially, we define a new resonant angle to describe the retrograde MMRs and then perform a series of canonical transformations to formulate the resonant model, in which the phase portrait, resonant centre and resonant width can be analytically determined.

arxiv-2210-11679.title: Planet Engulfment Signatures in Twin Stars numpy ( Harris et al. 2020 ) , matplotlib ( Hunter 2007 ) , pandas ( Wes McKinney 2010 ) , scipy ( Virtanen et al. 2020 ) , astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ; Astropy Collaboration et al. 2018 )
arxiv-2210-11679.creator: Aida Behmard, Jason Sevilla, Jim Fuller
arxiv-2210-11679.description: Abstract Planet engulfment can be inferred from enhancement of refractory elements in the photosphere of the engulfing star following accretion of rocky planetary material. Such refractory enrichments are subject to stellar interior mixing processes, namely thermohaline mixing induced by an inverse mean-molecular-weight gradient between the convective envelope and radiative core.

arxiv-2212-12254.title: Drop encapsulation and bubble bursting in surfactant-laden flows in capillary channels
arxiv-2212-12254.creator: Paula Pico 1, L. Kahouadji 1, S. Shin 2, J. Chergui 3, D. Juric 3,4, O. K. Matar 1
arxiv-2212-12254.description: Abstract We present a parametric study of the unsteady phenomena associated with the flow of elongated gas bubbles travelling through liquid-filled square capillaries under high Weber number conditions. These conditions consistently induce the formation of a re-entrant jet at the back of the bubble that commonly gives way to a deep liquid cavity.

arxiv-2312-12206.title: Identification of Causal Structure in the Presence of Missing Data with Additive Noise Model
arxiv-2312-12206.creator: Jie Qiao, Zhengming Chen, Jianhua Yu, Ruichu Cai, Zhifeng Hao
arxiv-2312-12206.description: Abstract Missing data are an unavoidable complication frequently encountered in many causal discovery tasks. When a missing process depends on the missing values themselves (known as self-masking missingness ), the recovery of the joint distribution becomes unattainable, and detecting the presence of such self-masking missingness remains a perplexing challenge.

arxiv-2402-00252.title: Reformulating polarized radiative transfer for astrophysical applications (I). A formalism allowing non-local Magnus solutions ∗ E-mails: ecarlin@iac.es, e.carlin.mail@gmail.com
arxiv-2402-00252.creator: Edgar S. Carlin 1,∗, Sergio Blanes 2, Fernando Casas 3
arxiv-2402-00252.description: Abstract The solar atmosphere is diagnosed by solving the polarized radiative transfer problem for plasmas in Non-Local Thermodynamic Equilibrium (NLTE). A key challenge in multidimensional NLTE diagnosis is to integrate efficiently the radiative transfer equation (RTE), but current methods are local, i.e. limited to constant propagation matrices.

arxiv-2402-09699.title: G-Drazin inverse combined with inner inverse
arxiv-2402-09699.creator: G. Maharana a,1 , J. K. Sahoo a,2 and Néstor Thome b
arxiv-2402-09699.description: Abstract This paper introduces new classes of generalized inverses for square matrices named GD1, and the dual, called 1GD inverse. In addition, we discuss a few characterizations and representations of these inverses. The explicit expressions of these inverses have been established via core-nilpotent decomposition.

arxiv-2403-07964.title: Optimal Design and Implementation of an Open-source Emulation Platform for User-Centric Shared E-mobility Services
arxiv-2403-07964.creator: Maqsood H. Shah, Yue Ding, Shaoshu Zhu, Yingqi Gu, Mingming Liu
arxiv-2403-07964.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Maqsood H. Shah, Yue Ding, Shaoshu Zhu, Yingqi Gu, Mingming Liu. With the rising concern over transportation emissions and pollution on a global scale, shared electric mobility services like E-cars, E-bikes, and E-scooters have emerged as promising solutions to mitigate these pressing challenges. However, existing shared E-mobility services exhibit critical design deficiencies, including insufficient service integration, imprecise energy consumption forecasting, limited scalability and geographical coverage, and a notable absence of a user-centric perspective, particularly in the context of multi-modal transportation.

arxiv-2409-16928.title: Quantum-Classical Sentiment Analysis
arxiv-2409-16928.creator: Mario Bifulco, Luca Roversi
arxiv-2409-16928.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Mario Bifulco, Luca Roversi. In this study, we initially investigate the application of a hybrid classical-quantum classifier (HCQC) for sentiment analysis, comparing its performance against the classical CPLEX classifier and the Transformer architecture. Our findings indicate that while the HCQC underperforms relative to the Transformer in terms of classification accuracy, but it requires significantly less time to converge to a reasonably good approximate solution. This experiment also reveals a critical bottleneck in the HCQC, whose architecture is partially undisclosed by the D-Wave property.

arxiv-2509-08746.creator: Ryan McGaughey 1 , Jesús Martínez del Rincón 2 and Ihsen Alouani 3
arxiv-2509-08746.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ryan McGaughey 1 , Jesús Martínez del Rincón 2 and Ihsen Alouani 3. Federated Learning (FL) is a distributed learning paradigm designed to address privacy concerns. However, FL is vulnerable to poisoning attacks, where Byzantine clients compromise the integrity of the global model by submitting malicious updates. Robust aggregation methods have been widely adopted to mitigate such threats, relying on the core assumption that malicious updates are inherently out-of-distribution and can therefore be identified and excluded before aggregating client updates.

arxiv-2510-16130.title: BASIN: Bayesian mAtrix variate normal model with Spatial and sparsIty priors in Non-negative deconvolution
arxiv-2510-16130.creator: Jiasen Zhang, Xi Qiao, Liangliang Zhang, Weihong Guo
arxiv-2510-16130.description: Abstract Spatial transcriptomics allows researchers to visualize and analyze gene expression within the precise location of tissues or cells. It provides spatially resolved gene expression data but often lacks cellular resolution, necessitating cell type deconvolution to infer cellular composition at each spatial location.

arxiv-2512-01936.title: Thermodynamic Geometry Through Second Order Phase Transitions
arxiv-2512-01936.creator: Omer M. Basri, Oren Raz
arxiv-2512-01936.description: Abstract A common approach to quantify excess dissipation in slowly driven thermodynamic processes is through the use of a Riemannian metric on the space of control parameters, where optimal driving protocols follow geodesics. Near phase transitions, this geometric picture breaks down as the metric diverges and geodesics may cease to exist.

arxiv-2512-06810.title: MMDuet2: Enhancing Proactive Interaction of Video MLLMs with Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2512-06810.creator: Yueqian WangWangxuan Institute of Computer Technology, Peking University wangyueqian@pku.edu.cn Songxiang Liu & Disong Wang & Nuo Xu & Guanglu WanMeituan {liusongxiang, xunuo19, wangdisong, wanguanglu}@meituan.com, Huishuai Zhang & Dongyan Zhao Wangxuan Institute of Computer Technology, Peking Unive
arxiv-2512-06810.description: Abstract Recent advances in video multimodal large language models (Video MLLMs) have significantly enhanced video understanding and multi-modal interaction capabilities. While most existing systems operate in a turn-based manner where the model can only reply after user turns, proactively deciding when to reply during video playback presents a promising yet challenging direction for real-time applications.
